profile.headline: Staff Engineer at Northrup Grumman Space Systems (formerly Orbital ATK)
profile.summary:
Senior level software engineer with full product lifecycle experience.

Specialties: Embedded systems, protocol stacks, TCP/IP, OSI, RTOS, DS1, DS3, SONET, RF Systems (X-band, Ku-band, Ka-band), 8 bit microcontrollers, 32 bit microprocessors.

company.name: Northrup Grumman Space Systems (formerly Orbital ATK)

positions.title: Sr. Software Engineer
positions.description: Working in the hub product group.  I helped design and implement an award winning FIPS 140-2 TRANSEC cryptographic module.

positions.title: Sr. Software Engineer
positions.description: Developed software for various products including a Ku-BUC, Ku/X-band test equipment, smart power supply, and protocol support for a high data rate modem.

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description: Developed software for a small form factor OC3 to DS1 optical multiplexer.  Coordinated Telcordia OSMINE conformance testing and acceptance.

positions.title: Senior Engineer
positions.description: Developed software for two carrier class switches, the Tellabs 8800 Multi-Service router and the Tellabs 5500 Transport switch.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Developed software for the 3Com 8xx family of residential and business xDSL routers and bridges.

positions.title: Senior Member Technical Staff
positions.description: Developed network management software and implemented an SNMP agent for a ATM switch jointly developed between US and French engineering teams.

volunteerExperiences.description: I am volunteering as a teaching assistant for the Computer Science AP class at Potomac Falls High School.
